snippet.title: Game Dev Academy
snippet.description:
Here you'll find weekly free Maya® tutorials covering 3D animation and 3D modeling, character modeling and rigging and also lighting and rendering. I also cover 3D theory including box and extrusion modeling, geometric theory, 3D modeling software and 
I also include animation tutorials using animation software such as Adobe Flash.

I spend a lot of time making sure that my tutorials are easy to follow and that they incrementally build your skills and confidence. I also read and respond to all comment so if you need any help then just get in touch!
